description: Defines the 'Request' class within the AWS CRT HTTP namespace, representing an HTTP request with possible body streaming capabilities, including methods for marshalling and unmarshalling.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with support for a body stream, extending the Message class, including marshalling capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an HTTP request object with method, path, query parameters, headers, and optional body stream. Validates the body stream type.

methods.name: marshall
methods.description: Serializes the Request object into a transmittable format by delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: unmarshall
methods.description: Creates a Request object from raw buffer data by delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: body_stream
methods.description: Returns the body stream associated with the request, if any.
